backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing user profiles, access-controlled image gallery storage, and blob-backed uploads with admin/user permission checks.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing two ElectronHoverLink-related UI features with associated files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose and behavior of major frontend components, utilities, styles, and data modules.
frontend/.gitignore: Git ignore rules for dependencies, build outputs, logs, environment files, IDE metadata, OS artifacts, and temp files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base/theme configuration defining OKLCH color tokens, dark mode variables, and global border/background styles.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML shell loading the Vite-built React app via root div and main.tsx module.
frontend/README.md: Project overview for the frontend with architecture details, setup prerequisites, and development instructions.
frontend/scripts/REDEPLOY.md: Runbook describing prerequisites and steps for performing a clean application redeploy using provided scripts.
frontend/scripts/redeploy.ps1: PowerShell script that reinstalls frontend deps, regenerates backend bindings, builds the frontend, and deploys the backend with logs.
frontend/scripts/redeploy.sh: Bash script performing dependency cleanup, backend binding generation, frontend build, and backend deploy with logging.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component orchestrating layout, category interactions, hover tracking, ElectronHoverLink connections, and overlay rendering.
frontend/src/components/CategoryModal.ts: Empty file placeholder for a category modal component.

frontend/src/components/HDDHub.tsx: Empty placeholder file with no implemented content.
frontend/src/components/PhotoGalleryOver: Empty placeholder file with no implemented content.
frontend/src/components/PortfolioShell.t: Empty placeholder file with no implemented content.
frontend/src/components/StudioComponents: Defines PortfolioShell for background handling and VinylPlayer for audio-playback with fallback images.
frontend/src/components/VinylPlayer.tsx: Empty placeholder file with no implemented content.
frontend/src/data/categories.ts: Exports a list of portfolio categories with names and descriptive text.
frontend/src/data/categoryOverlayContent: Provides placeholder overlay sections per category including text blocks and photo metadata.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages authenticated or anonymous backend actors using React Query and Internet Identity.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, login flow, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/usePhotoGallery.ts: Hooks for listing, uploading, and checking admin status for images via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers, theme CSS variables for light/dark mode, and custom utilities/animations like glass effects, slow spin, shadows, and category hover effects.
frontend/src/lib/assetFallbacks.ts: Empty file placeholder for asset fallback logic.
frontend/src/lib/assets.ts: Provides functions to resolve asset URLs, generate SVG placeholders, and defines fallback chains for images.
frontend/src/lib/assetUrls.ts: Empty file placeholder for asset URL helpers.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Exports a helper that merges class names using clsx and tailwind-merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and renders App.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL and sessionStorage parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending colors, animations, fonts, and adding plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
frontend/vite.config.ts: Vite config enabling React, env variable injection, proxying /api, and alias resolution.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, features, and new feature requests for the Shibhi Studio project.
